svg.title: Four visual and navigation terrain conditions
svg.desc: Measured cross sections from TerrainCueLab. Blue is visible ground, dashed orange is navigation ground, purple is the eye path. Arrows show left-to-right heading and terrain-induced pitch. Vertical scale is exaggerated.
svg.text: Four primary conditions • identical 1 cm clearance above the navigation surface
Hugs the terrain: height and tilt change
Flat visible plane; hidden terrain changes height and tilt
Cross-section at z = 0, x = −20 to +20 cm. Travel →. Vertical scale exaggerated; arrow angles share that scale.
